Wingman Privacy Policy

Effective Date: September 6, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Blufeather Labs LLC, doing business as "Highschool Wingman" and the operator of Wingman ("Wingman," "we," "us," or "our"), collects, uses, processes, and protects information in connection with the Wingman beta. Highschool Wingman is a trade name (DBA) of Blufeather Labs LLC.

Wingman is designed to help high-school students discover and organize extracurricular activities, competitions, internships, programs, and other opportunities.

By using Wingman, you acknowledge the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

1. Information We Collect

We collect information that users voluntarily provide to Wingman.

Depending on how you use the Service, this may include:

Account information

  • name;
  • email address;
  • account credentials or authentication information; and
  • information necessary to establish and maintain your account.

Student profile information

Users may choose to provide information such as:

  • interests;
  • activities;
  • educational information;
  • goals;
  • location information;
  • extracurricular experiences;
  • preferences;
  • college-preparation information; and
  • other information they choose to include in their profile.

You control what information you provide to your profile.

Resume and profile uploads

Wingman allows users to provide resume or profile information by:

  • uploading a PDF or text file; or
  • pasting profile information into Wingman.

Uploaded files are processed to extract or use relevant information for Wingman features. Wingman does not retain the uploaded file itself after processing.

Information extracted from or provided through an upload may become part of your Wingman profile and may be retained according to this Privacy Policy.

Automatically collected information

We may automatically collect certain technical and usage information when you use Wingman, including information such as:

  • browser and device information;
  • IP address;
  • approximate location derived from technical information;
  • pages or features accessed;
  • dates and times of access;
  • basic usage information;
  • event and interaction data — such as clicks, taps, scrolling, mouse movement, and navigation between pages — collected through analytics and session-replay tools; and
  • information collected through cookies or similar technologies.

We do not intentionally collect precise geolocation information.

2. How We Use Information

We use information to operate and improve Wingman.

For example, we may use information to:

  • create and maintain user accounts;
  • build and update user profiles;
  • identify opportunities that may be relevant to users;
  • rank opportunities based on information users provide;
  • generate activity recommendations;
  • organize saved opportunities;
  • generate deadlines and tasks;
  • provide and improve Wingman features;
  • maintain security;
  • detect misuse;
  • understand how users interact with Wingman;
  • troubleshoot technical problems;
  • communicate with users about the Service; and
  • develop and improve Wingman.

3. AI Processing

Wingman uses artificial intelligence to provide certain features.

Information contained in a user's profile may be sent to third-party AI service providers, including Anthropic and Google, to process information and provide features such as opportunity ranking, profile generation, recommendations, and other functionality.

We do not represent that third-party AI providers will retain or process information exactly as Wingman does. Their own policies and contractual arrangements may apply to their processing.

We do not intentionally use user information to train our own AI models.

We also do not represent that third-party providers will never use information for model training or other purposes outside Wingman's direct control. We will seek to use appropriate provider configurations and agreements consistent with our intended privacy practices.

4. Opportunity Recommendations

Wingman may use information in a user's profile to identify and rank opportunities.

Before a user's profile contains sufficient information for personalized ranking, Wingman may allow the user to browse available opportunities without personalized AI ranking.

Once sufficient profile information is available, Wingman may use that information to determine which opportunities may be more relevant to the user.

The recommendations are not guarantees and should not be interpreted as professional admissions or educational advice.

5. Information We Do Not Collect Intentionally

Wingman does not intentionally collect precise GPS location information.

Wingman also does not currently provide public profiles, public posts, social feeds, user-to-user messaging, or other features designed to make student profile information publicly available.

Your Wingman profile and activity information are intended to remain private.

6. Sharing Information

We do not sell users' personal information.

We may share or provide access to information with service providers when reasonably necessary to operate Wingman.

These providers may include:

  • artificial-intelligence providers;
  • hosting and infrastructure providers;
  • analytics providers;
  • authentication providers;
  • security providers; and
  • other technical service providers.

We may also disclose information when reasonably necessary to:

  • comply with law or legal process;
  • protect the rights, safety, or property of users or others;
  • investigate fraud, abuse, or security incidents;
  • enforce our Terms; or
  • protect Wingman or its users.

If Wingman is ever sold, transferred, reorganized, or combined with another business, information may be transferred as part of that transaction, subject to applicable law.

6A. Mailing-List Signup

If you use Wingman's optional mailing-list signup feature, we send your first and last name and the email address you confirm at the time to the organization's mailing-list provider, so that they can add you to their list.

This happens only for an opportunity you individually select and confirm. We do not send your details to any organization otherwise.

We keep a record of each signup you make: which opportunity, which email address you used, when it was submitted, and what the organization's provider answered. You can see this record in your Quest Log. We keep it so you can find what was sent on your behalf, and so we can tell whether a signup went through.

We cannot see whether you completed the organization's confirmation step, and we do not receive the organization's emails to you. Once your details reach the organization, their handling of that information is governed by their own privacy policy, not this one.

7. Analytics and Cookies

Wingman may use cookies, analytics tools, and similar technologies to understand how users interact with the Service, maintain functionality, improve performance, and diagnose problems.

These technologies include session-replay, heatmap, and product-analytics tools that collect event data — a record of interactions such as page views, clicks, taps, scrolling, mouse movement, navigation between pages, and the approximate time and sequence of these actions — so we can see how the Service is used, reproduce problems, and improve the experience. We use this event data in aggregate and to diagnose specific issues; we do not use it to make automated decisions about you.

Wingman uses Microsoft Clarity, a product-analytics and session-replay service provided by Microsoft Corporation, to capture this event data. Microsoft Clarity is configured to mask the content you type into fields, so the text you enter (such as profile answers, resume text, and passwords) is not recorded. Microsoft processes the data it collects in accordance with its own privacy terms; you can read more in the Microsoft Privacy Statement.

The specific analytics and technology providers used by Wingman may change over time.

We will update this Privacy Policy as necessary when our material data practices change.

8. Minors and Parents

Wingman is available only to users 13 years of age or older.

Users under 18 must have permission from a parent or legal guardian before using Wingman.

We encourage parents and guardians to discuss online privacy and the information their students choose to provide to Wingman.

Wingman does not knowingly permit children under 13 to create accounts or use the Service.

If we learn that we have collected personal information from a child under 13 without legally required parental consent, we will take reasonable steps to delete the information as required by applicable law.

Parents or guardians who have questions about a minor's use of Wingman may contact us at:

contactus@highschoolwingman.com

9. Information Retention

We retain information only for as long as reasonably necessary to:

  • provide Wingman;
  • maintain user accounts;
  • provide requested features;
  • maintain security;
  • comply with legal obligations;
  • resolve disputes; or
  • otherwise fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Policy.

Uploaded resume and profile files are not retained after they have been processed for the relevant feature.

Information derived from those files may remain in a user's Wingman profile unless deleted or otherwise removed in accordance with our retention practices.

You can delete your account and its associated information at any time (see Section 10). After deletion, we retain only information we are required or permitted to keep by law — such as billing and tax records held by our payment processor, and a minimal, non-identifying record that a deletion occurred.

10. Deletion

You can delete your account, and everything associated with it, at any time from within Wingman: go to Manage Plan → Your data → Delete my account. You will be asked to confirm your password before the deletion proceeds.

Deleting your account permanently removes your profile, your tracked and saved opportunities, your account details, and the other information associated with your account. This cannot be undone. If you have a paid subscription, it is cancelled as part of the deletion.

Some information may be retained where required by law or necessary to protect security — for example, our payment processor retains billing and tax records it is legally required to keep, and we keep a minimal, non-identifying record that a deletion occurred. We do not retain your name, email, profile, or other personal information after deletion except as described here.

You may also request deletion by contacting contactus@highschoolwingman.com. We will evaluate and respond to such requests in accordance with applicable law and our ability to verify the request.

11. Security

We take reasonable measures designed to protect information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

However, no internet-based service can guarantee absolute security.

You should avoid providing information that is not reasonably necessary for using Wingman.

12. Third-Party Websites and Services

Wingman may reference or link to third-party websites, organizations, programs, or opportunities.

Those third parties have their own privacy practices. This Privacy Policy does not apply to information you provide directly to third parties.

You should review the privacy policies of third parties before providing them with personal information.

13. Changes to This Privacy Policy

As Wingman develops, our data practices may change.

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will provide reasonable notice, such as by displaying a notice within Wingman or sending an email.

The updated Privacy Policy will become effective on the date indicated at the beginning of the updated policy.

14. Your Choices

Depending on the information involved and applicable law, you may have rights concerning your personal information, including rights to request access to, correction of, or deletion of certain information.

You can download a copy of the information Wingman holds about your account at any time from Manage Plan → Your data → Download my data, and you can delete your account as described in Section 10.

To make other requests, contact:

contactus@highschoolwingman.com

We may need to verify your identity or authority before completing certain requests.

15. Contact Us

Wingman is operated by:

Blufeather Labs LLC
doing business as "Highschool Wingman"
Washington, United States

For privacy questions, requests, or concerns:

contactus@highschoolwingman.com
